title: Banana Milk Smoothie
steps: Peel the banana and add it to a blender.|Add milk and honey.|Blend 30 seconds until smooth.|Pour and serve cold.

title: Apple Honey Snack Plate
steps: Wash and slice the apple thin.|Arrange on a plate.|Drizzle with honey.

title: Fresh Orange Juice
steps: Halve the oranges.|Squeeze with a juicer.|Strain out the seeds and serve over ice.

title: Roasted Carrots with Honey
steps: Heat oven to 425F.|Toss carrot sticks with olive oil, salt, and honey.|Roast 25 minutes, turning once.

title: Broccoli Stir Fry
steps: Cut broccoli into small florets.|Heat olive oil in a pan over high heat.|Stir fry 5 minutes until bright green.|Season with salt and pepper.

title: Carrot Orange Salad
steps: Grate the carrots.|Segment the orange.|Toss with honey and a pinch of salt.

title: Apple Carrot Slaw
ingredients: apple, carrot, honey, olive oil, salt
steps: Julienne the apple and carrot.|Whisk honey, olive oil, and salt.|Toss and rest 10 minutes.

title: Broccoli Milk Soup
steps: Steam broccoli until tender.|Warm milk with butter in a pot.|Blend the broccoli into the milk.|Simmer 5 minutes and season.

title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana in a bowl.|Stir in flour, milk, and sugar.|Cook ladles of batter in butter, 2 minutes per side.

title: Cinnamon Apple Bites
steps: Dice the apple.|Toss with sugar and cinnamon.|Wrap spoonfuls in thin squares of dough.|Bake at 375F for 20 minutes.

title: Warm Banana Milk
steps: Warm the milk gently.|Mash in half a banana.|Stir in honey and serve warm.

title: Orange Banana Fruit Salad
steps: Segment the orange.|Slice the banana.|Toss gently with honey.

title: Steamed Broccoli with Butter
steps: Steam the florets for 6 minutes.|Toss with melted butter and salt.

title: Honey Glazed Carrots
steps: Slice carrots into coins.|Simmer in a little water for 8 minutes.|Drain, add butter and honey, glaze 3 minutes.

title: Warm Apple Banana Mash
steps: Dice the apple and cook 5 minutes until soft.|Mash with the banana.|Dust with cinnamon.

title: Broccoli Carrot Medley
ingredients: broccoli, carrot, olive oil, salt, pepper
steps: Cut both into bite-size pieces.|Steam 8 minutes.|Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.

title: Orange Glazed Carrots
steps: Juice the orange.|Simmer carrot coins in the juice 10 minutes.|Add butter and honey and reduce to a glaze.

title: Banana Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread.|Spread with butter.|Top with banana slices and honey.

title: Apple Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread.|Spread with butter.|Top with thin apple slices and honey.

title: Grilled Hot Dog
steps: Simmer the hot dogs 5 minutes.|Toast the buns.|Assemble and add condiments.

title: Hot Dog with Glazed Carrots
ingredients: hot dog, bread, carrot, honey, butter
steps: Glaze sliced carrots with honey and butter.|Simmer the hot dogs.|Serve together in toasted buns.

title: Broccoli Apple Salad
ingredients: broccoli, apple, honey, olive oil, salt
steps: Chop broccoli small and dice the apple.|Whisk honey, olive oil, and salt.|Toss and chill 10 minutes.

title: Carrot Apple Juice
steps: Chop both roughly.|Juice or blend with water and strain.|Serve over ice.

title: Banana Orange Smoothie
steps: Segment the orange.|Add banana and honey to a blender.|Blend until smooth.

title: Apple Oat Breakfast
steps: Warm the milk.|Dice the apple small.|Combine, top with honey and cinnamon.

title: Mashed Carrots
steps: Boil carrot chunks 15 minutes.|Drain and mash.|Stir in butter, milk, salt, and pepper.

title: Cinnamon Baked Apples
steps: Core the apples.|Fill with honey, cinnamon, and butter.|Bake at 375F for 25 minutes.

title: Banana Cinnamon Snack
steps: Slice the banana.|Dust with cinnamon and drizzle honey.

title: Roasted Broccoli
steps: Toss florets with olive oil and salt.|Roast at 425F for 20 minutes until crisp at the edges.

title: Carrot Fries
steps: Cut carrots into fry shapes.|Toss with olive oil and salt.|Roast at 425F for 25 minutes.

title: Apple Butter Toast
steps: Cook diced apple with butter, sugar, and cinnamon 10 minutes.|Mash onto toasted bread.

title: Orange Carrot Slaw
steps: Grate the carrot.|Segment the orange.|Toss with olive oil and salt.

title: Milk and Honey Warmer
steps: Warm the milk.|Stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Leftover Pizza Refresh
steps: Heat a pan over medium heat.|Warm the pizza slice 3 minutes.|Drizzle with olive oil and serve.

title: Cake with Warm Milk
steps: Warm the milk.|Serve a slice of cake alongside.

title: Broccoli Stalk Soup
steps: Peel and chop the broccoli stalks.|Simmer in milk 15 minutes.|Blend with butter and salt.

title: Caramelized Bananas
steps: Slice bananas thick.|Melt butter with sugar in a pan.|Caramelize 2 minutes per side.|Drizzle with honey.

title: Apple Cinnamon Milk
steps: Warm the milk with cinnamon.|Grate in half an apple.|Sweeten with honey and strain.

title: Orange Broccoli Toss
steps: Steam broccoli 5 minutes.|Toss with orange segments, olive oil, and salt.
